title: product.built@1
description: A build product's entry the hub kept in a repo's product store (#1017): built from the default branch's commit in a checkout of its own, keyed by its inputs, and ready to clone into each worktree whose own files make that key.

subject.description: The record object this event is about.

writer.description: Only the core appends this kind.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

product.description: The product's name, as done.yaml's environment.products gives it.

path.description: Its folder, relative to a checkout's top.

key.description: The digest of its key files' bytes and its key values, as the default branch's checkout makes them.

commit.description: The default branch's commit, as last fetched, it was built from.

bytes.description: The bytes the entry's files hold.

store_bytes.description: The bytes the repo's whole store holds once it is kept.
